findings.highlight: with no windows to show you what’s inside
findings.evidenceJa: 昼なお締め切った窓ガラスは客の出入りを不明にし
findings.governingReading: even in daytime its closed windows conceal the coming and going of customers
findings.explanation: Existing windows kept shut are replaced by a windowless building, and concealed customer traffic becomes concealed interior appearance.

findings.highlight: The manager traveled abroad to train his cooking arts, so maybe he trained with the devils.
findings.evidenceJa: 店の名前も泰山だし、修行して帰ってきたっていう店長は獄卒に違いない
findings.governingReading: the restaurant is even named Taishan, so its returned-from-training proprietor must be a warder of hell
findings.explanation: The restaurant name’s role in the Enma-and-hell escalation disappears, while the proprietor is changed from a hell warder into someone who trained with devils.

findings.highlight: I promised to be here right after school
findings.evidenceJa: 学校が終わったらすぐに来い、との事だった
findings.governingReading: he was told to come immediately after school
findings.explanation: Rin’s instruction is reassigned to Shirou as a promise.

findings.highlight: It looks as if the spicy oil and red pepper were cooked together for a hundred years just to be used in that dish.
findings.evidenceJa: ラー油と唐辛子を百年間ぐらい煮込んだ地獄の釜にも匹敵しそうな料理
findings.governingReading: a dish seemingly comparable to a hell cauldron in which chili oil and peppers have simmered for a century
findings.explanation: A grotesque comparison to a hell cauldron becomes an account of ingredients prepared for the dish.

findings.highlight: Don’t just keep standing and sit down.
findings.evidenceJa: 立っていては話にならんだろう。座ったらどうだ
findings.governingReading: we cannot talk while you stand; why not sit down?
findings.explanation: The coordination tells Shirou both not to keep standing and to sit down in a malformed construction.

findings.highlight: I watch in amazement
findings.evidenceJa: こいつ、ホントにアレを完食する気か
findings.governingReading: is he truly planning to finish the whole thing?
findings.explanation: Shirou’s specific disbelief at Kirei’s intention to clean the plate disappears.

findings.highlight: I watch in amazement when
findings.evidenceJa: 喉を鳴らした時
findings.governingReading: when Shirou gulps
findings.explanation: A physical reaction is replaced by an abstract emotion and attached to the following action.

findings.highlight: …He’s lying.
findings.evidenceJa: ……よく言う
findings.governingReading: what a thing for him to say / he has some nerve
findings.explanation: Shirou’s incredulous reaction is promoted into a factual claim that Kirei is lying.

findings.highlight: Caster still exists
findings.evidenceJa: キャスターはまだ現界していて
findings.governingReading: Caster remains manifested in the world
findings.explanation: A precise claim about continued Servant manifestation is generalized into existence.

findings.highlight: if he hides his presence
findings.evidenceJa: アサシンが完全に引きこもってしまえば
findings.governingReading: if Assassin withdraws and conceals himself completely
findings.explanation: The ungendered Japanese is assigned a male pronoun before the figure’s identity is established.

findings.highlight: trying to find an opening to attack
findings.evidenceJa: 俺たちを倒す機会を窺っていた
findings.governingReading: watching for an opportunity to defeat us
findings.explanation: The imagined objective is weakened from defeating the group to merely attacking it.

findings.highlight: Something is different from the last war.
findings.evidenceJa: 前回とは違うモノが動いている気がしてならんのだ
findings.governingReading: Kirei cannot shake the feeling that something unlike the previous war is moving
findings.explanation: The unsettling impression of an active unknown entity disappears into a generic difference between wars.

findings.highlight: you came out and gave me information
findings.evidenceJa: 一方的に話された事だけど
findings.governingReading: although the information was told to me unilaterally
findings.explanation: Shirou’s recognition that Kirei imposed the exchange is omitted.

findings.highlight: It seems he knows every move I’m going to make. But I’m not going to fall for his tricks that easily.
findings.evidenceJa: こっちの出方なんてお見通しって顔だ
findings.governingReading: he wears a look saying Shirou’s response was entirely foreseen
findings.explanation: Reading Shirou’s immediate response is exaggerated into knowing his every move, and “tricks” are inserted into the follow-up.

findings.highlight: Neither Saber nor Archer, Tohsaka’s Servant, could tell.
findings.evidenceJa: セイバーも、アーチャーを有する遠坂も、柳洞寺の事は知らなかった
findings.governingReading: neither Saber nor Rin, who has Archer, knew what had happened at Ryuudou Temple
findings.explanation: Rin is replaced by Archer as the second knower, and lack of knowledge becomes failed sensory detection.

findings.highlight: But that ended last night.
findings.evidenceJa: だがそれも昨日までの話だ
findings.governingReading: but that was only true through yesterday
findings.explanation: A day-level boundary is narrowed to a specific nighttime ending.

findings.highlight: He wants answers.
findings.evidenceJa: ただ明確な回答だけを、言峰神父は求めている
findings.governingReading: Kirei demands only clear answers
findings.explanation: The demand for unambiguous, direct answers loses its defining restriction.

findings.highlight: what happened to me after making my contract with Saber four days ago
findings.evidenceJa: この神父と出会った後に起きた出来事
findings.governingReading: the events that occurred after contracting Saber and meeting this priest four days ago
findings.explanation: Kirei’s own first meeting with Shirou disappears from the reporting interval.

findings.highlight: The information I provided is mostly useless.
findings.evidenceJa: 言峰にとってはあまり意味のない情報
findings.governingReading: information of little significance to Kirei
findings.explanation: Limited relevance to Kirei becomes general uselessness.

findings.highlight: Matou ZoukenI thought he had withered away
findings.evidenceJa: 間桐臓硯とうに老衰したかと思っていたが
findings.governingReading: Matou Zouken—I thought he had long since succumbed to old age
findings.explanation: A missing boundary fuses Zouken’s name to “I” and leaves the sentence visibly malformed.

findings.highlight: The magic of the Matou family is absorption.
findings.evidenceJa: 間桐の魔術は吸収でな
findings.governingReading: Matou Magecraft is absorption
findings.explanation: The setting-specific discipline of Magecraft is rendered as undifferentiated magic.

findings.highlight: he has lived for a few hundred yearsbut
findings.evidenceJa: 数百年を生き抜いたというがさて
findings.governingReading: he is said to have survived for centuries, but who knows
findings.explanation: A missing space and punctuation produce “yearsbut,” while Kirei’s skeptical trailing qualification disappears.

findings.highlight: a parasitic insect
findings.evidenceJa: 吸血虫だよ
findings.governingReading: a bloodsucking insect
findings.explanation: The pointed bloodsucker classification and its continuation of the vampire language are generalized to parasitism.

findings.highlight: He is like a counselor for the Matou familybut
findings.evidenceJa: 間桐家の相談役のようなものだがなにぶん
findings.governingReading: he is something like an adviser to the Matou family, but after all
findings.explanation: A missing boundary again fuses “family” and “but,” visibly corrupting the exposition.

findings.highlight: Caster after her Master was killed
findings.evidenceJa: マスターのいなくなったキャスター
findings.governingReading: Caster, whose Master is gone
findings.explanation: The source states absence; the English promotes the Master’s death into the modifying clause.

findings.highlight: he must believe his victory is certain
findings.evidenceJa: 確かな勝算があっての事だろう
findings.governingReading: he presumably has a sound prospect or calculation for victory
findings.explanation: A strong but probabilistic calculation is inflated into certainty of victory.

findings.highlight: the worst devil in Makiri history
findings.evidenceJa: マキリにおける最悪の魔術翁
findings.governingReading: Makiri’s worst old magus
findings.explanation: The title for an old practitioner of Magecraft becomes a devil and gains an unsupported claim of historical ranking.

findings.highlight: I shall try to suppress the damage.
findings.evidenceJa: 被害の拡大に備えるとしよう
findings.governingReading: he will prepare for the spread of harm
findings.explanation: Preparation for possible wider damage is rewritten as an attempt to suppress present damage.

findings.highlight: My goal is not a serious matter
findings.evidenceJa: だがそれは聖杯で叶えるべき事ではない
findings.governingReading: but it is not something that should be fulfilled through the Holy Grail
findings.explanation: Kirei’s explicit distinction between having a purpose and using the Grail to fulfill it disappears.

findings.highlight: we cannot seek salvation
findings.evidenceJa: 救いなど求めてはいない
findings.governingReading: we do not seek salvation
findings.explanation: A statement about what Kirei and Shirou do not desire is changed into incapacity, materially altering his proposed likeness between them.

findings.highlight: I feel like he has grabbed my heart in his hand.
findings.evidenceJa: 心臓を鷲づかみにされる感覚
findings.governingReading: a sensation as though his heart has been seized in a fist
findings.explanation: A bodily simile is made into an action specifically performed by Kirei.

findings.highlight: I constrict my wavering eyes
findings.evidenceJa: 揺らぎそうな両目を懸命に絞って
findings.governingReading: straining to focus eyes that threaten to waver
findings.explanation: The English copies the Japanese verb into a physically unnatural description of constricting one’s eyes.

findings.highlight: The second and third plates of mapo tofu are placed on the table.
findings.evidenceJa: ごとんごととん
findings.governingReading: the heavy clunk-clunk of the second and third mapo-tofu servings landing on the table
findings.explanation: The heavy staggered sound cue punctuating the interruption disappears.

findings.highlight: Kotomine picks up his spoon.
findings.evidenceJa: かしゃん、と新たにレンゲを手にとる言峰
findings.governingReading: with a clink, Kirei takes up a fresh Chinese spoon
findings.explanation: The audible clink and the fact that the spoon is fresh are omitted.

findings.highlight: I answer him with a straight face.
findings.evidenceJa: 真顔で、力の限り返答した
findings.governingReading: Shirou answers with a dead-serious face and all his strength
findings.explanation: The callback retains the straight face but loses the renewed full-force intensity of Shirou’s refusal.

findings.highlight: started eating the mapo tofu
findings.evidenceJa: もくもくとマーボーを食い始めた
findings.governingReading: began eating the mapo tofu silently and steadily
findings.explanation: Kirei’s wordless, absorbed manner of eating disappears.
